sources.excerpt: CHASE BLISS AUDIO BROTHERS AM MANUAL Pdf Download | ManualsLib Sign In Upload Download Add to my manuals Delete from my manuals Share URL of this page: HTML Link: CHASE BLISS AUDIO BROTHERS AM MANUAL Pdf Download '> Pinterest Bookmark this page Add Manual will be automatically added to "My Manuals" Print this page × Bookmark added × Added to my manuals Manuals Brands Chase Bliss Audio Manuals Music Pedal Brothers AM Manual Chase Bliss Audio Brothers AM Manual Hide thumbs Also See for Brothers AM : Manual (19 pages) 1 2 page of 2 Go / 2 Bookmarks Quick Links Download this manual Twins of Tone GAIN 1 & 2 A Controls the amount of drive and saturation (will also influence the overall volume). VOLUME 1 & 2 B Controls the output loudness. TONE 1 & 2 C Controls the voicing, allowing you to brighten or darken the sound. MODE SELECTION D Selects the circuit, choosing between BOOST, OVERDRIVE, or DISTORTION. Made in collaboration with Analog Man, Brothers AM is a triple stack of saturation based on the King of Tone transparent overdrive. Brothers AM is three circuits in series: B A C H D G Time to get warmed up. Two identical, multi-mode gain channels A unique, two-voice treble booster TREBLE BOOSTER E A Engages a treble booster that pushes the upper mid and treble frequencies. The treble booster is linked to and engaged by Channel 1, and comes at the very front of the circuit. B C PRESETS F The left and right positions each store a H preset, while the middle position is live (current settings). There is a second D bank accessible via dip switch as well. E BYPASS 1 & 2 G Tap to turn each of the channels on / off. PRESENCE H F Lets you boost the high frequencies for a more airy and brilliant sound. To change the PRESENCE setting, hold down the BYPASS footswitch and adjust the TONE G knob for the channel you want to control. BOOST CHANNEL CHANNEL (Hidden option) Previous  Page Next  Page 1 2 Need help? Do you have a question about the Brothers AM and is the answer not in the manual?
